title: Felix and the Visitor
author: Yara Villalobos
blurb: Ansel Okonkwo, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the last resident signs the papers.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
